step_pair.title: Pair Your Host
step_pair.subtitle: Connect in seconds
step_pair.description: Install the PocketShell agent on any machine, generate a pairing code in the app, and run `pocketshell pair <CODE>` on your host. That's it — secure P2P connection established.
step_terminal.title: Full Terminal Access
step_terminal.subtitle: Real shell, real power
step_terminal.description: Get a complete terminal with Ctrl keys, arrow navigation, tab completion, search, and clipboard support. Attach to tmux or screen sessions seamlessly.
step_workspaces.title: Workspaces & Files
step_workspaces.subtitle: Organize your workflow
step_workspaces.description: Create workspaces with multiple terminal tabs and file browser panels. Browse, edit, and transfer files directly between your phone and remote host.
step_monitor.title: Live Monitoring
step_monitor.subtitle: Know your systems
step_monitor.description: Watch CPU, memory, disk, and network stats in real time. Set alert thresholds and get notified when something needs attention — all over a secure WebRTC channel.
